Why Travel Here

Reasons patients fly to Dr. Meghana

Specialist-led, not assembly-line

Your entire treatment is planned and performed by one MDS specialist with a smile-design focus, not rotated between juniors. The same eye that designs your smile is the one that delivers it.

A fraction of Western prices

The same internationally-branded veneers, implants and materials typically cost a small fraction of UK, US, Australian or Gulf fees, often making the trip pay for itself, holiday included.

Microscope & laser dentistry

Dental operating microscope, laser-assisted procedures and digital smile design, the same advanced standard you'd expect from a premium Western practice.

English-speaking & documented

Fluent English consultations, written treatment plans and digital records you can take home for any follow-up with your local dentist.

Easy to reach

Banjara Hills is the heart of Hyderabad, 30–40 minutes from Rajiv Gandhi International Airport, surrounded by hotels, restaurants and landmarks for an easy, comfortable stay.

Treatment that fits your trip

Timelines are sequenced so most cosmetic work is completed in a single short visit, with the rest planned around your travel dates.

One specialist, start to finish

The same dentist who plans your smile is the one who delivers it.

At Smera, everything is planned and performed by one MDS specialist, not rotated between juniors, not handed off. The same eye that designs your smile is the one that places every veneer, guides every instrument, and makes every decision.

That continuity is what patients from the Gulf, the UK, the US and Australia come specifically for, and what makes the trip worth it.

How It Works

From a reel to your new smile

A simple, four-step path designed for patients who live oceans away.

1
Message & share photos

Send a WhatsApp with a few photos of your smile and what you'd like to change. Dr. Meghana reviews them personally.

2
Video consult & plan

A video call to discuss options, then a written treatment plan, timeline and transparent quote, before you book a single flight.

3
Travel & treat

We help you time your trip. Most veneer and smile-design cases are completed in one short visit; implants are staged with your schedule in mind.

4
Fly home & follow up

You leave with your records and aftercare guidance, plus remote check-ins on WhatsApp whenever you need them.

Best Suited For Travel

Treatments worth the trip

Smile design & veneers

Composite or ceramic veneers and full smile makeovers, typically completed in 2 visits across roughly 5–8 days, ideal for a single trip.

Full-mouth implants

Single, full-arch and zygomatic implants. Planned in stages so most of the work, and recovery, fits comfortably around your travel.

Full-mouth rehabilitation

Combining crowns, restorations and gum work to rebuild a worn or damaged smile completely, coordinated into the fewest possible visits.

Good To Know

Travel, stay & safety

Stay & logistics

Recommendations for hotels and serviced apartments within minutes of the clinic, plus guidance on airport transfers and getting around the city.

Visa & documentation

On request, we provide an appointment-confirmation letter to support a medical/tourist visa application, plus a clear schedule of your visits.

Safety & sterilisation

Strict sterilisation protocols, single-use disposables where appropriate and internationally-recognised implant and ceramic brands, quality you can verify.

Meet Your Dentist

Dr. Meghana Varma, MDS

Dr. Meghana Varma is an endodontist and restorative dentist with a Master of Dental Surgery in Conservative Dentistry & Endodontics. She founded Smera Dental Clinic in Banjara Hills on a simple belief: that exceptional dentistry is personal, precise and unhurried.

With over four years dedicated to micro-endodontics and restorative dentistry, she brings meticulous, magnified precision to every treatment, whether saving a tooth with a single-sitting root canal or crafting a natural-looking set of veneers. Her aesthetic eye means function and beauty are always planned together.

Philosophy

Why a boutique practice?

In a single-doctor practice, nothing about you gets lost in handovers. Dr. Meghana plans, performs and follows up on your treatment personally, so your care is consistent, and your trust is earned over time.

The space is intentionally calm and private. Appointments are spaced to avoid rushing, and options are always explained in plain language, including suitability, alternatives and considerations, so you can decide with confidence.

What guides every visit
  • Listen first. Understand your concern before recommending anything.
  • Treat conservatively. Preserve natural tooth structure wherever possible.
  • Design aesthetically. Plan beauty and function together, never in isolation.
  • Explain honestly. Clear options, no pressure and no upselling, ever.
